findings.title: Concurrent winner protocol was underspecified
findings.details: Two first requests could build different snapshots and the existing exact-retry service would reject the loser instead of returning the stored winner.

findings.title: Timezone and cutoff were not one pinned contract
findings.details: The plan did not prevent settings drift between source classification and persistence or define source timestamp cutoff fields.

findings.title: Section source predicates were incomplete
findings.details: Statuses, due boundaries, earlier-work semantics, multi-linked Changes, caps and tie order were not executable policy.

findings.title: Safe narrative projection was asserted but not designed
findings.details: The plan did not name a field-by-field frozen projection or strict client allowlist for mutable Action, Change and Result text.

acceptanceGaps: Test contention with genuinely different first-build snapshots.
Test settings-timezone drift and one pinned cutoff.
Specify every section predicate, cap, sort and source rule.
Test safe frozen and client projections with credential, email, ID, hash and URL canaries.
evidence: Fresh read-only Bodkin plan review of the run plan, acceptance contract, ADR-027 and current Reports service/repository.
